In this paper, we do not study the question of EA-equivalence of the (2m, t)-bent functions
deﬁned above. In general, this is a very diﬃcult question. We only remark that Weng, Feng
and Qui [23] proved that most of the PS type bent functions, obtained from a Desarguesian
spread are not EA-equivalent to any Maiorana–McFarland bent function.
